lead.headline: Priority spent on a fourth back; Downs into the flex
lead.deck: Gordon was claimed overnight and doesn't start. The moves that start, Downs and Sadiq, were free.
lead.body: The overnight Gordon claim spent IPADE priority, which never resets, on a running back who projects 9.3 and sits behind Taylor, Barkley and Tuten; Bloodsports is now 8th in the order. The other two moves were free and both start: Josh Downs, the Colts' slot starter against Washington's 31st-ranked pass defense, and Kenyon Sadiq, whose 23.5 came with Mason Taylor out. Oronde Gadsden, the tight end he replaced, scored 0.0 in Week 3 and his add closes WRONG. The lineup is 0.8 from the projection lineup: put Downs in the flex over Golden before London kicks off at 07:30 Sunday. No starter is questionable. ESPN has you at 120.5 against Team 13's 112.3; Team 13 are also the Lamar trade partner, so that offer waits until Week 4 is final.
